services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing, sightseeing cruise along the beautiful Emerald Coast or satisfy your inner daredevil with a high-intensity ride through the bay! Renting a jet ski is the perfect way to explore the area in a small group at high speed. Discover the white-sand beaches and idyllic coves full of native birds, fish, and other wildlife. What you need to know There is a two person or 450 lb. weight limit per jet ski. This is the law and will be strictly enforced. You are responsible for booking the correct number of skis.
